identity: Explicit canonical party or actor UUID only. Never inferred from owner, hold date or advisory waiting_on role.
display: Resolve current party merge chains to the survivor. A deleted, missing or inactive identity has available=false and display_name=null. Unknown or cleared waiting_on is null.
versions: item_version is the Home item's base_version. base_version is its independent waiting_version, initially 0. Both must match. Waiting writes never alter item base_version or ownership.
audit: Every set, replacement, clear and canonical completion records a durable receipt. Each explicit command requires a UUID idempotency_key, nonblank reason and 1-20 nonblank evidence references. Exact retries replay the historical receipt; read v4 for current identity.
completion: Completion clears the relationship and increments its version in the canonical write transaction. Reopening work does not restore an old waiting identity. A completed item refuses a new wait.
tenancy: The existing Home and canonical party/actor store belongs to carr-internal. A foreign tenant refuses before identity resolution or replay.
